input_format: uint32 BGRX: B bits7:0, G bits15:8, R bits23:16, ignored high byte
geometry: Output width/2 by height/2, raster order, no crop
packet: AXI stream TKEEP=0xf. TLAST only on final pixel of full input/output frame, not line endings.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Write 1 starts; write 4 aborts/clears. Read bits busy0/done1/idle2/fault3.

registers.name: INPUT_COUNT
registers.description: Accepted input pixels in current/last frame.

registers.name: OUTPUT_COUNT
registers.description: Transferred output pixels in current/last frame.

registers.name: LAST_CYCLES
registers.description: Cycles through final output handshake, includes stream stalls.

registers.name: COMPLETED_COUNT
registers.description: Successful final output TLAST handshakes; uint32 wraps.

registers.name: ERROR
registers.description: Latched error; valid start or clear resets.

error_codes.2: Busy configuration/start rejected and frame aborted
error_codes.4: Expected final input pixel has no TLAST (overrun)

dma.mode: simple, no SG, no micro DMA
dma.port: PS HP0 DDR, 512 MiB address range

notes: Source contract only: this JSON is not a real HWH or evidence of successful synthesis.
Arm output S2MM before starting input MM2S. Buffers must be DMA-capable and aligned to 8 bytes because DRE is disabled.
One input pixel per clock when unstalled; all B/G/R channels computed together. No array reset. Actual Fmax/resources need Vivado reports.
completed_count increases only once final output pixel is transferred. Merely starting DMA does not count.
Protocol faults abort image output; a partial S2MM transfer may stay pending. Software must reset DMA after a bounded timeout and clear/reload image core before retry.
CTRL clear cancels current frame, clears frame counts/status, preserves cumulative completed_count.
